name: Embodied Simulation of Others' Emotional States
description: Cross-framework template linking embodied cognition with interoception. Observing emotions triggers motor simulation that feeds interoceptive circuits, generating empathic resonance.

key_references.citation: Keysers, C., & Gazzola, V. (2009). Expanding the mirror: Vicarious activity for actions, emotions, and sensations. Current Opinion in Neurobiology, 19(6), 666-671.
Lamm, C., & Singer, T. (2010). The role of anterior insular cortex in social emotions. Brain Structure and Function, 214(5-6), 579-591.
Gallese, V. (2005). Embodied simulation: From neurons to phenomenal experience. Phenomenology and the Cognitive Sciences, 4(1), 23-48.

causal_links.mechanism_summary: Observed emotional expressions activate mirror neuron system in premotor cortex
Motor simulation drives insula interoceptive representation via somatosensory projection
Interoceptive simulation generates felt emotional response (empathic resonance)
